```json
"rationale": "A simple mirror gives about 0.75 MOhm, so a cascode is needed. R in the input branch biases the cascode gate IR above the mirror gate. M1 and M2 then sit at the same small VDS of about 0.13 V, which gives low error. Weak-inversion cascodes (gm/Id about 22) need about 0.1 V. Compliance is about 0.23 V. Rout = gm4*ro4*ro2, about 20-40 MOhm. Total current is 40 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_m": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),   # mirror devices M1/M2
    "L_m":    (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "gmid_c": (22.0, 12.0, 26.0),   # cascode devices M3/M4
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.25, 2.0),
    "vds1":   (0.13, 0.08, 0.2),    # target VDS of mirror devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", iin)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # mirror pair, both at the same VDS = vds1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], iin, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], iout, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source sits at vds1, which gives body effect
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iin, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout, vds=max(vout - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)

    # series resistor: VA = VB + I*R and VA - Vgs3 = vds1, with VB = Vgs1
    vr = vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs
    R = max(vr, 0.02) / iin

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin(A) -R- B ; M3 drain=B gate=A ; M1 drain=x gate=B
    n.R("R1", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2)

    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / m4.gds / m2.gds + 1.0 / m2.gds
    vcomp = vds1 + max(m4.vdsat, 4 * UT) + 0.01
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": 0.5,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "rout": rout,
        "power": 1.8 * (iin + iout),
    }
```
